title: Geometric and coefficient operations on a fixed semilinear system calculus
statement: Fix the Data structure of [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus] for an arbitrary inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on a small site. For every geometric morphism presented by a finite-limit-preserving inverse image on sheaves, there is a Geometry structure of [def-coef-semilinear-geometry-ops] whose PullTransitionFormula holds. For every compatible morphism of ring towers there is a ScalarSystems structure, and for every object of the site there is an OpenSystems structure. The push-transition formula and projection-evaluation equality are not assumptions of this result: they are proved categorically in the parent module.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23-24; the ordinary ringed-topos-of-systems construction and its evaluation adjunction, generalized here from quotient constant rings to ring sheaves. Other operations use Stacks Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4, 07A6, 08J7-08JB. This is the ordinary-derived-route restatement requested by the human, 2026-10-18 (coord/returns/NF.md).

proof.text: Choose the independently normalized geometric and coefficient-extension branches. For open localization, construct a left adjoint to actual openRestriction using free-representable presentations and coefficient-universe sheafification. The section-normalized restriction comparison has an invertible left mate by the sequence-evaluation theorem. Use that mate to identify the left adjoint levelwise with actual extension by zero. Componentwise exactness proves exactness. The mate identities give the evaluated unit and counit, and exact localization of the ordinary adjunction gives the derived transpose. Assemble these three fields.

proof_origin.place: Assembly of the independent geometric, coefficient-extension, and exact open-localization constructions; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.
